The '''Separatist Council Conference Room''' was a meeting room in the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|mining facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], hidden deep within a secure bunker used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The members of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] convened here during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

During his [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|slaughter]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] killed [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] secretary in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], leaving his body on the floor. Techno Union [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] shared his fate in the same room. Vader's fierce [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] with his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], took both combatants through the Conference Room. During this duel, the arm of [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] was seen to twitch.
